meta.title: FAQ and help | Taskote
meta.description: Frequently asked questions about Taskote services, enquiries, payments and professional registration.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.lead: Helpful answers about services, WhatsApp enquiries, payments and joining as a professional.

categories.title: Services and enquiries
items: How do I enquire about a service?
Browse the service categories on this website, then click 'Enquire on WhatsApp' or message our WhatsApp Business number with your job requirement and location.
Which services does Taskote cover?
Taskote currently lists eight primary service categories: AC Repair, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Appliance Repair, Painting, Cleaning, and Pest Control.
Is Taskote only for homes?
No. Taskote is a local services marketplace for residential and commercial requirements, including homes, shops, offices, and other establishments across Kerala.
How do I know what a service covers?
Each service category page outlines what kinds of work are typically covered, helpful signs to watch for, and practical preparation tips before work begins.

categories.title: Pricing and payments
items: Can I pay through this website?
No. This website does not accept payments or charge transaction fees. Service fees are settled directly between you and the service professional as agreed.
How do I know the price of a job?
Charges depend on the exact scope of work, labor required, and replacement parts or materials. You can discuss job details and estimates directly when enquiring via WhatsApp.

categories.title: For skilled professionals
items: How do I join Taskote as a professional?
Click 'Register on WhatsApp' or send a message to our WhatsApp Business number with your trade, experience, and the areas in Kerala where you work.
What are the requirements to join?
You should be an experienced tradesperson or technician operating in Kerala with reliable local references and a commitment to quality work.
Which trades can register?
We welcome professionals specializing in AC Repair, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Appliance Repair, Painting, Cleaning, and Pest Control.

categories.title: Launch and WhatsApp support
items: Do I need to create an account or download an app?
No. For our public launch, all customer enquiries and professional registrations are handled directly via WhatsApp Business. No account or password is required.
Why is Taskote operating via WhatsApp?
WhatsApp offers instant, direct communication between customers, professionals, and the Taskote team without the friction of app downloads or account logins.
How can I reach the Taskote team?
You can message us directly on WhatsApp Business or submit a query through our Contact page.

bottomCta.title: Still have questions?
bottomCta.text: Send us a message on WhatsApp or get in touch through our contact page.
